info.title: Void API
info.description: Void migration compatibility contract. Organization login, identity creation and navigation, and customer bindings are implemented in Polar. Other operations preserve the imported SDK API for later backend migration.

remaining.title: Remaining
remaining.description: What the tightest holder or cap up the chain has left; None when nothing limits it.

overage.title: Overage
overage.description: The tightest holder's usage past its credits.

limited_by.title: Limited By
limited_by.description: The identity whose holding or cap sets `remaining`.

Balance.title: Balance
Balance.description:
Where one identity stands on a meter.

`usage` and `credits` are the identity's own: what its subtree spent and
what it holds. `remaining` and the fields after it come from the chain,
the way `check` sees it: the tightest holder or cap above or at this
identity. A child that holds nothing still gets a real number here.

remaining.title: Remaining
remaining.description: What the tightest holder up the chain has left.

external_identity_id.title: External Identity Id
external_identity_id.description: The holder with the least remaining, or None if there is none.

customer_id.title: Customer Id
customer_id.description: Existing Polar customer to bind. Its external ID must match or be unset.

next_change_at.title: Next Change At
next_change_at.description: Next known billing boundary or subscription change.

checksum.title: Checksum
checksum.description: Hash of the config this was compiled from. Stored with the deployment; clients send it back on every request.

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Compute the plan against current state; write nothing.

preview.description: Compare changed usage prices without applying them.

id.title: Id
id.description: The server id after apply. Unset on a dry run create.

reducer.title: Reducer
reducer.description: Slug of a scalar reducer in this deploy.

credit_reducer.title: Credit Reducer
credit_reducer.description: Slug of a sum reducer in this deploy supplying credits. When omitted, a credit.granted reducer is created automatically.

meters.title: Meters
meters.description: Slugs of meters in this deploy.

entitlements.title: Entitlements
entitlements.description: Slugs of entitlements in this deploy.

EntitlementAssignment.title: EntitlementAssignment
EntitlementAssignment.description: Narrow inherited access. None inherits; an empty list denies all.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name; defaults to the slug.

external_identity_id.title: External Identity Id
external_identity_id.description: The holder in the chain whose subscription grants this.

EntitlementGrant.title: EntitlementGrant
EntitlementGrant.description: One held entitlement and the subscription up the chain that grants it.

external_id.title: External Id
external_id.description: Stable event id for retrying this assignment change.

external_root_id.title: External Root Id
external_root_id.description: The root of the actor's tree, stamped at ingest: the billable identity a customer owns. Never sent by the merchant.

external_identity_id.title: External Identity Id
external_identity_id.description: Who performed the action: a billing identity that already exists. Usage rolls up from it through its parents to the root of its tree.

parent_external_id.title: Parent External Id
parent_external_id.description: Parent for a new identity. Existing identities keep their parent.

chain.title: Chain
chain.description: External IDs from this identity to its root.

meters.title: Meters
meters.description: Current mainline meter balances, keyed by meter slug.

entitlements.title: Entitlements
entitlements.description: Entitlement slugs held through this identity's chain.

MeterEntitlement.title: MeterEntitlement
MeterEntitlement.description: Access to an inherited meter, optionally capped in its usage units.

entitlement_usage_base.title: Entitlement Usage Base
entitlement_usage_base.description: Reduced usage from entitlement period start up to snapshot.since.

default_variant_id.title: Default Variant Id
default_variant_id.description: Default configuration variant. Null selects the unnamed variant.

start.title: Start
start.description: Inclusive UTC date, using processed buckets.

event_ids.title: Event Ids
event_ids.description: Exact events represented by this bucket result.

meter_ids.title: Meter Ids
meter_ids.description: Meters billed at each boundary. Recurring products only.

ends_at.title: Ends At
ends_at.description: When access stops. Unset while running without a cancel.

current_period_start.title: Current Period Start
current_period_start.description: Unset for one-time products and ended subscriptions.

State.title: State
State.description: The ledger seen on its own: remaining and overage from its own credits.

at_period_end.title: At Period End
at_period_end.description: Keep access until the next boundary. False ends it now.

product_id.title: Product Id
product_id.description: The product generation to sell; the newest one, normally.

starts_at.title: Starts At
starts_at.description: Anchor for every boundary. Defaults to now; never in the future.

ends_at.title: Ends At
ends_at.description: Import an already-ended subscription: canceled at this past moment, with its cancel events stamped there. Must follow starts_at.

SubscriptionCycle.title: SubscriptionCycle
SubscriptionCycle.description: One closed period, priced at read time from the stored meter cycles.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.description: Distinct subscription ids in the stream.

orphaned.title: Orphaned
orphaned.description: Rows with no lifecycle events behind them. Left in place.

SubscriptionRebuild.title: SubscriptionRebuild
SubscriptionRebuild.description: What re-projecting rows from the lifecycle events changed.

oat.description: An organization access token with Void scopes. For local development, use scripts.generate_void_token for an allowlisted organization.
